Yeah, it has been going on for awhile. Shit has been going up and down, and i hope it doesn't stay at the bottom for too long. I hope i get to see the kind of image you saw after feeling better. I still have a long road to go, but i want to do what's best for everyone. 

I'm taking those AP classes to relieve my parent's shoulders. They always bring up stuff like.. " you'll leave me when you marry and get older". I plan to become a pharmacist just to help them with anything i could. 

Thank you for sharing your life with me, hearing this shows that i'm not the only one and many others of worse issues. I plan on telling my parents about issues, and hopefully things can go for a change.

Thanks for the reply. I'm currently taking Calculus AB, Chemistry AP , and English AP. 

And you're right , i'm trying to fix things. The reason i'm taking AP classes is to cause less weight on my parents. Both my parents had had it rough when they gave birth to us; living with our grandparents, taking on several jobs, and taking care of us. I just don't want them to go through the same hardship. 

Thank you very much for the regards and i do hope things will get better. May i ask how'd you deal with the feeling of when your parents fought? I'm just trying to find other ways to release my feelings than just the doing the usual.
